g.text: A bridge capacitor charges near peaks and supplies the load between recharge intervals

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Teaching ideal source/instantaneous recharge model with stipulated constant diode drops. Between conduction intervals, capacitor discharges through R_L.
Curves zoom near output peak; lower input voltage is clipped by axis limits intentionally. Ripple estimate ΔV≈I_load/(2f_line C) assumes small ripple;
source impedance and narrow high charging pulses are not solved. Initial capacitor voltage is the peak10.6 V.
